Package io.github.jspinak.brobot.tools.history.draw

Class DrawMatch

java.lang.Object
io.github.jspinak.brobot.tools.history.draw.DrawMatch
@Component public class DrawMatch extends Object
Provides high-level drawing operations for visualizing match results on images.

This class builds upon DrawRect to provide specialized functionality for drawing collections of matches with consistent styling. It supports drawing matches on both raw scenes and layered illustrations, making it a key component in the Brobot visualization pipeline.

Key features:

  • Batch drawing of multiple matches
  • Default and custom color support
  • Scene-aware filtering of matches
  • Multi-layer drawing on Illustrations objects

Default visualization:

  • Default color: Pink/Purple (RGB: 255, 150, 255)
  • Rectangles drawn with 1-pixel padding around matches
  • Automatic null-safety for illustration layers

Common use cases:

  • Visualizing find operation results
  • Debugging pattern matching accuracy
  • Creating annotated screenshots for reports
  • Highlighting multiple UI elements simultaneously

  • Method Details

    • drawMatches

      public void drawMatches(org.bytedeco.opencv.opencv_core.Mat scene, List<Match> matchList)
      Draws rectangles around all matches using the default pink/purple color.

      This convenience method uses a predefined color that provides good visibility on most backgrounds. Each match is drawn with a 1-pixel padding around its boundaries.

      Parameters:
      scene - The OpenCV Mat image on which to draw. Must not be null.
      matchList - List of matches to visualize. Empty lists are handled safely.

    • drawMatches

      public void drawMatches(org.bytedeco.opencv.opencv_core.Mat scene, List<Match> matchList, org.bytedeco.opencv.opencv_core.Scalar color)
      Draws rectangles around all matches using a custom color.

      This method allows for color customization, useful when different match types need distinct visual representation or when adapting to specific background colors.

      Parameters:
      scene - The OpenCV Mat image on which to draw. Must not be null.
      matchList - List of matches to visualize. Empty lists are handled safely.
      color - The color for the rectangles as an OpenCV Scalar (B,G,R,A format).

    • drawMatches

      public void drawMatches(Visualization illScn, ActionResult matches)
      Draws matches from an ActionResult onto multiple illustration layers.

      This method performs scene-aware filtering, only drawing matches that belong to the current scene. Matches are drawn on both the scene layer and the classes layer of the Illustrations object, providing multiple visualization perspectives.

      The filtering process:

      1. Extracts matches from the ActionResult
      2. Filters matches by scene name
      3. Draws filtered matches on available layers

      Layer handling:

      • Scene layer - Shows matches on the raw screenshot
      • Classes layer - Shows matches with class/type annotations
      • Null layers are safely skipped
      Parameters:
      illScn - The Illustrations object containing visualization layers and scene context.
      matches - The ActionResult containing matches to draw. Matches are filtered by scene name.
